actions.action: Check whether the soil stays wet and whether the base stems feel soft or smell bad
Lift the pot to judge soil moisture by weight
Move the plant to a stable 18–24°C spot away from drafts and cold glass
Check the top inch of soil with a finger before watering
Water thoroughly until it drains when the top inch is dry
Remove fully brown, black or mushy leaves with clean scissors
Monitor for a new leaf unfurling

reason: The answer correctly names cold damage from transport as the main cause, but its advice (keep the leaves, keep watering when dry, wait) misses the fix that worked (cut back to 1 cm, no watering, humidity jar), though its watering is safeguarded by a soil check, so it is not clearly harmful.
